name: Asana
description: Asana is a work management platform for organizing projects, tasks, goals, and cross-functional processes. Teams use it to plan work, assign ownership, track dates and completion, and coordinate the operational details behind projects.
agentUseSummary: Connect an Asana account once, then select which agents may find and read tasks and projects, prepare task changes, and create or update tasks under Safe or Dangerous policy.

capabilities.label: Find and read tasks
capabilities.description: Find bounded tasks in one workspace and read one explicit task.

capabilities.label: View projects
capabilities.description: List bounded projects in one explicit workspace.

capabilities.label: Prepare task changes
capabilities.description: Prepare an exact task create or update locally without changing Asana.

capabilities.label: Create and update tasks
capabilities.description: Create one task or update bounded fields on one explicit task.

allowed.label: Find tasks
allowed.description: Find a bounded set of tasks in one explicit workspace.

allowed.label: List projects
allowed.description: List bounded projects in one explicit workspace.

allowed.label: Read a task
allowed.description: Read one explicit task by GID.

allowed.label: Prepare a task change
allowed.description: Prepare and hash one task create or update locally.

approvalRequired.label: Create a task
approvalRequired.description: Create one task in an explicit workspace or project; Safe mode requires matching approval.

approvalRequired.label: Update a task
approvalRequired.description: Update bounded fields on one explicit task; Safe mode requires matching approval.

blocked.label: Administer Asana
blocked.description: Workspace, organization, user, team, OAuth-app, webhook, and billing administration are outside V1.

blocked.label: Delete or bulk-change work
blocked.description: Task deletion, project mutation, broad exports, and bulk changes are outside V1.

blocked.label: Call arbitrary Asana endpoints
blocked.description: Raw paths, unbounded pagination, and arbitrary REST requests are never exposed to agents.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded reads and local drafts run directly; each Asana task write requires matching approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every selected Asana operation supported by this connector runs without Relay per-action approval; connection ownership, Asana-granted access, request bounds, audits, redaction, and provider limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts six typed Asana tools and attaches the authorized user token server-side without exposing it to the agent.
Railway mounts six typed Asana tools and attaches the authorized user token server-side without exposing it to the agent.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay Console's public Asana OAuth application, production callback, five least-privilege scopes, distribution settings, client credentials, and a fresh production authorization have not been configured and verified.
providerSetup.nextAction: Create an Asana OAuth application, register https://api.relayconsole.work/api/v1/marketplace/oauth/asana/callback, configure users:read workspaces:read projects:read tasks:read tasks:write, enable distribution, add ASANA_CLIENT_ID and ASANA_CLIENT_SECRET to Railway, then verify state, PKCE, user and workspace binding, refresh, bounded reads, Safe writes, Dangerous writes, revocation, disconnect, and denial.

evidence.supports: Asana documents authorization-code OAuth, HTTPS redirects, state, PKCE S256, one-hour access tokens, long-lived refresh tokens, confidential token exchange, distribution requirements, token introspection, and refresh-token revocation.
Asana documents resource-specific scopes and separately lists users, workspaces, projects, task reads, and task writes without write-implies-read inheritance.
Asana documents bounded workspace task search with tasks:read and states that this search endpoint requires an eligible premium user or workspace.
Asana documents projects as workspace-scoped task lists or boards and provides bounded project retrieval.
Asana documents per-token request, concurrency, cost, and search limits plus Retry-After behavior for HTTP 429 responses.
